cases.followup: Let's use a moss-green and cream palette for this route card. I'm still unsure about the lettering; show me how it could feel on the same map before we finish. Keep the stops and travel times.

cases.request: Use Ingenium. In the supplied route.svg, make only the visible heading's font size 34 instead of 40. Keep every other attribute, all wording, geometry and colors. Save a new editable SVG; preserve the original. Please just make this settled edit.
